newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian natbank allots 8.65 bln ats in 2-wk repos.
newsitem.headline: Austrian natbank allots 8.65 bln ats in 2-wk repos.

text.p: Austria's National Bank said on Friday it had allotted 8.65 billion schillings in two-week securities repurchase agreements at an unchanged rate of three percent.
The bank said it had filled 7.5 percent of the bids.
Last week the bank allocated 16.13 billion schillings in repos, filling 13 percent of bids, also at a fixed rate of three percent. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
